Name: Zen garden desert obelisk
Author: Pixibee
Description:
Hello :)
This version ONLY includes the desert obelisk

I also have a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5563]mod with Monteso's obelisks[/url] for content patcher on my mod page. :)

__________________________
Main file:
This mod requires SMAPI and content patcher to work

How to download WITH content patcher: (recommended)
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install content patcher
3. Place the mod into the /Mods folder
4. Unzip it
5. Enjoy!

Optional file:
How to download WITHOUT content patcher:
1. Place the .xnb mod file within /content/buildings and let it overwrite
2. Enjoy!

Please dont redistribute this mod without my permission.
